subject: DPA evidence pack and eSign timeline — cross-border controls & incident notification
messages:
From: Samir Rao <samir.rao@finservco.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@finservco.com
Date: 2026-10-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: DPA redlines + evidence pack request (FinServCo)

Lauren — thanks for the call today. As discussed, procurement/legal at FinServCo need: a) your latest DPA with any redlines tracked, b) an evidence pack (SOC2, encryption attestations, subprocessors list) to complete our vendor security review, and c) confirmation on eSign platform for execution (we prefer DocuSign).

Two specific asks up front:
- Incident notification: our legal team requires "initial notice within 24 hours of detection" and a full incident report delivered as soon as available (we'll follow up on the exact scope).
- Cross-border transfers: clarify your transfer mechanism to the EU (SCCs, UK Addendum, or BCRs) and whether you perform a DTIA.

I've attached our questionnaire and our initial DPA comments (PDF). Procurement timeline: we are trying to close vendor acceptance by 2026-10-10. Can you confirm when you can send the evidence pack and whether you can accept DocuSign?

Samir
FinServCo — Vendor Risk & Procurement
Attachments: FinServCo_Security_Questionnaire_20261001.pdf, FinServCo_DPA_Redlines_20261001.docx

From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Rao <samir.rao@finservco.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, michael_grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-01T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: DPA redlines + evidence pack request (FinServCo)

Samir — appreciate the clear asks and the timeline. Quick plan from our side:
1) We will produce an "evidence manifest" containing SOC 2 Type II summary, encryption-at-rest/in-transit attestation, subprocessors snapshot, and our DTIA summary by EOD 2026-10-04. We will provide a secure transfer link for the package.
2) Legal is reviewing your redlines now (Marissa). Expect a redline summary and proposed compromise language by 2026-10-02.
3) Regarding incident notifications: our standard position is initial notice "without undue delay" and a follow-up report within 72 hours. We recognize your 24-hour requirement — Marissa, can you weigh in on what we can commit to for initial notice content vs. full packet timing?
4) eSign: we support both AdobeSign and DocuSign; preference is AdobeSign for embedded flow (auditable metadata), but we can route to DocuSign if that is procurement policy.

I'll keep procurement copied; Marissa/Neha/Michael are on the thread for legal/security specifics.

Thanks — Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Samir Rao <samir.rao@finservco.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, michael_grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-02T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: DPA redlines + evidence pack request (FinServCo)

Samir / Lauren — legal here. Initial read of FinServCo's redlines: several high level items to note and our proposed moves:
- Incident notif. (Paragraph 6): FinServCo requests "initial notice within 24 hours" and a full technical report shortly thereafter. We propose: 24-hour initial notice containing: detection timestamp, affected systems, and high-level impact; an interim technical update within 72 hours; and a substantive final report as soon as the investigation concludes (we are pushing for a 30-day maximum for final root cause where possible). This preserves our ability to avoid sharing immature forensics.
- Subprocessors / SSAE: We will provide the current subprocessor snapshot (attached) and a mechanism for 30-day notice for new subprocessors; for critical subprocessors we will offer direct audit evidence (SOC2 Type II or ISO27001).
- Cross-border transfers: we accept SCCs + UK Addendum for transfers from EU/UK to the US and will provide a DTIA summary.
- Liability / caps: we'll seek to keep the existing monetary cap language; open to discussing carve-outs limited to willful misconduct.

Please see the attached redline summary (redline_summary_marissa_20261002.pdf). If FinServCo requires an unconditional 24-hour "full packet" delivery, that's materially different and we will need a legal escalation.

Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
Attachments: redline_summary_marissa_20261002.pdf

From: Samir Rao <samir.rao@finservco.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@finservco.com
Date: 2026-10-03T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: DPA redlines + evidence pack request (FinServCo)

Marissa — thanks for the quick read. A couple clarifications from our side:
- Our legal team is firm that initial notice must be provided within 24 hours and should contain as much of the technical packet as is available at point of detection (we understand forensics evolve, but procurement can't accept "high-level only").
- eSign: procurement policy requires DocuSign for contract auditability in our SAP system. If you can push the agreement through DocuSign, we can accept the process.
- Subprocessors: we need a live CSV of active subprocessors and the date they were added. Also confirm whether any subprocessors are located in India or other APAC jurisdictions — regulatory team flagged certain data flow concerns.

Procurement timeline remains 2026-10-10; if you can send the evidence pack by 2026-10-04 and confirm DocuSign support, we should be able to proceed to signature.

Samir
Attachments referenced: FinServCo_DPA_Redlines_20261001.docx

From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Rao <samir.rao@finservco.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, michael_grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-04T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: DPA evidence pack delivery + subprocessors snapshot

Samir — security here. We've prepared the evidence manifest and are making the materials available via secure transfer. Summary of what you'll receive and expected timelines:
- Evidence package (secure SFTP link, ACL-limited): SOC 2 Type II report (redacted where necessary), system architecture diagram, encryption attestations (KMS/HSM used for customer keys), MDR contact details, and our subprocessors snapshot (CSV attached). Delivery ETA: secure link sent 2026-10-04 17:00 PST.
- Subprocessor detail: attached CSV includes name, country, role, date onboarded. Current list includes one APAC subprocessor (Singapore-based logging provider); no India-hosted subprocessors for production customer data.
- Cross-border transfers: we rely on Commission SCCs + UK Addendum for EU/UK transfers and have completed a DTIA summarizing compensating controls; will include that as a PDF in the package.
- Incident notification commitments: we can commit to 'initial notice within 24 hours' as a business practice for FINANCIAL customers, provided the notice contains incident summary fields (detection time, affected customers, initial severity classification). Full technical packet will be delivered via secure channel within 72 hours where possible; if investigations require more time we'll provide interim updates and a target 30-day root cause report.

Attached: subprocessors_snapshot_20261001.csv, evidence_manifest_20261004.csv
Neha Kapoor
Director of Security, Redwood Inference

- Timeline: proposed DocuSign send date 2026-10-06, target signature by 2026-10-07 to meet your vendor close date.
